maes_1.why: Simultaneous equations are challenging but I can learn to solve them with practice.

maes_2.why: Decimals come naturally once you understand the concept of place value.

maes_3.why: Finding missing angles requires memorizing angle relationships and applying them correctly.

maes_4.why: Algebra problems are abstract and require strong problem-solving skills to tackle.

maes_5.why: Trigonometry deals with triangles and circles, which I find very difficult without visual aids.

maes_6.why: Calculating area and volume involves complex formulas that are hard to remember precisely.

maes_7.why: Sketching curves requires understanding of functions and their properties, which I struggle with.

maes_8.why: Fractions can be confusing, but with repetition I become more comfortable working with them.

maes_9.why: Finding missing side lengths in triangles is straightforward only for basic cases.
